spark_open.description: A single quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of sandy ground with sparse grass and tiny white flowers. The animal has a tan, short-furred mammalian body with four sturdy legs and a short, thick, bushy tail. Its head is feline in shape with a spotted tan face, amber eyes, and black tear-stripes. The entire dorsal region from the back of the neck to the rump and down the upper flanks is covered by a dense mantle of overlapping black feathers that contrasts sharply with the tan fur of the underside, chest, legs and tail. A narrow white stripe runs along the lower edge of the black mantle and a small yellow patch is visible at the front edge of the mantle near the shoulder.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged mammal-like creature standing in side view facing right with its head turned toward the viewer. It has a tan short-furred body, chest, and long muscular legs ending in broad paws, a cheetah-like head with black spots and black tear lines, small rounded ears, and a short bushy tan tail hanging at the rear. The back from behind the neck to the rump is covered by a thick mantle of overlapping black feathers, bordered below by a white stripe along the flank and a small yellow patch at the shoulder.
